provenance: [D-syn] Independent grading of untimed synthetic task simulations. These results cannot predict timed human success and are not human comprehension evidence.
method: Applied short and role-specific long criteria separately to actual answer text. No peer grades or coordinator conclusions read. PASS means supplied answer satisfies this key; it does not resolve recorded confusion or establish conversion, practical execution or timing.
timing_limit: The source headings sometimes say three-minute; neither timing label is a measured human window. Short is the frozen first-fold response and long is subsequent self-directed browsing.

read_context.key_and_reused_facts: Same published key and permitted frozen Get Started/About/Community/State/Canonical Properties/What is aDNA text read during prior calibration.
read_context.scope_limit: Additional spot checks support criterion assessment, not exhaustive fact checking of every sentence or verification of the project’s asserted measurements.
